videos.title: How to Think Like a Strategist and Always Get What You Want
summary: Sandeep Swadia opens this episode, sponsored by Zapier MCP, with the premise that most people negotiate poorly because they either cave too fast, lean on manipulation, or push aggressively for a 'win,' and argues that having a system beats having a tactic.

He walks through his four-step 'PACE' framework for negotiating at work and at home: reading the Person across the table (Fighters, Fact Checkers, or Friends), building leverage by knowing your Arm (your BATNA and alternatives), Calibrating through active-listening tools like echoing and asking 'how/what' instead of 'why,' and working to Earn a lasting deal rather than a one-time concession.

The episode is framed as general negotiation and communication coaching rather than an AI or tech-tool video; beyond the Zapier MCP sponsor read at the top, no AI model or assistant is discussed or demonstrated, so it is classified as No AI technology for this report.
